title: arenaria pulvinaris
intro: Arenaria pulvinaris, commonly known as Sandwort, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is a perennial plant native to the Mediterranean region and is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Arenaria pulvinaris include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic actions, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
